'''''Applied Mathematics Letters''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published monthly by [[Elsevier]]. Established in 1988,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Rodin |first1=Ervin Y. |title=Editorial introduction |journal=Applied Mathematics Letters |date=1988 |volume=1 |issue=1 |pages=1-2 |doi=10.1016/0893-9659(88)90162-0}}</ref> it focuses on short and rapid communications in [[applied mathematics]].<ref name="overview">{{cite web |title=Aims and scope: Applied Mathematics Letters|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/applied-mathematics-letters/about/aims-and-scope |website=sciencedirect.com |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |access-date=August 25, 2026}}</ref> Its current [[editor-in-chief|editors-in-chief]] are [[Alan Tucker]] ([[Stony Brook University]]) and Patrick Winkert ([[Technische Universität Berlin]]).<ref name="editorial">{{cite web |title=Editorial board: Applied Mathematics Letters |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/applied-mathematics-letters/about/editorial-board |website=sciencedirect.com |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |access-date=August 25, 2026}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
*[[Current Contents]]/Physical, Chemical & Earth Sciences<ref name=ISI/>
*[[EBSCO Information Services|EBSCO databases]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Ei Compendex]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Inspec]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[MathSciNet]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Science Citation Index Expanded]]<ref name=ISI>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/ |title=Web of Science Master Journal List |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |access-date=August 24, 2026}}</ref>
*[[Scopus]]<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title= Applied Mathematics Letters |issn= 0893-9659 |access-date=August 25, 2026}}</ref>
*[[zbMATH Open|zbMATH]]<ref name=MIAR/>

According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2025 [[impact factor]] of 2.7.<ref name="WoS">{{cite book |year=2026 |chapter= Applied Mathematics Letters |title=2025 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
